name: services/mailclient/update_message
description:
Update a message.

This method works only with messages with status draft.

arguments.name: subject
arguments.description: Subject of the message. No more than 200 characters.

arguments.name: from_inst_address_id
arguments.description:
Institutional address ID from which the message should be sent, or null if user's email address should be used instead.

Most users do not have any institutional address assigned so in most cases this value will be null.

arguments.name: content
arguments.description: Content of the message. No more than 15000 characters.

arguments.name: send_summary
arguments.description: Should the summary report (as described in services/mailing/send_simple_message method) be sent to the user?

arguments.name: send_to_myself
arguments.description: Should the copy of the message be sent to the user?

arguments.name: attachments_lifetime
arguments.description:
The number of days the attachments should be available for.

The time starts counting from the moment the message is sent. After this time attachments will be automatically deleted.

arguments.name: format
arguments.description: Format in which to return values. See supported output formats.

arguments.name: callback
arguments.description: Required only if you've chosen jsonp as a return format.

returns:
An empty dictionary returned if the method has been executed successfully.
    Some keys may be added in the future.
errors:
• object_forbidden - access to institutional address denied.

    Possible reasons:

    • inst_address_unassigned - institutional address was not assigned to you.

  • object_invalid - message is in invalid state.

    Possible reasons:

    • draft_required - message is not a draft.

  • object_not_found - institutional address could not be found; param_name is equal to from_inst_address_id;

  • object_not_found - message could not be found; param_name is equal to message_id.
